name: EL-FLOW Select F-201CV
subtitle: Thermal mass flow controller in the 1K0 nominal flow configuration
description: This EL-FLOW Select F-201CV uses the 1K0 model range. Bronkhorst specifies a nominal air range up to 1000 mlₙ/min for this configuration; the exact calibration medium and full-scale setting of the seeded instrument are not recorded.
